issue.title: 3.6: Rename detectFacebookPixel*
issue.body_excerpt: Names that lie. Update imports and tests. No exported detectFacebookPixel that detects 50 networks.

affected_files.role: primary - rename 3 exported functions (detectFacebookPixel, detectFacebookPixelScripts, detectFacebookPixelElements)
imports and calls the 3 functions; describe blocks name them

analysis.current_implementation: src/lib/pixel-detector.js exports three functions with 'Facebook' in the name: detectFacebookPixelScripts (line 604), detectFacebookPixelElements (line 647), and detectFacebookPixel (line 708). All three are actually multi-platform (50+ networks per TRACKING_PLATFORMS). The names are misleading. detectFacebookPixel also internally calls both Scripts and Elements versions.
analysis.limitations: Names violate the 'no lying in code' clean-code rule. New contributors reading the public surface expect Facebook-only behavior; the comprehensive-platform behavior is hidden in the body.
analysis.change_surface: 4 files. Rename exports in pixel-detector.js; update 2 import sites (content-script.js, content-script.test.js); rename describe blocks and call sites in pixel-detector.test.js (40+ references). Suggested names: detectTrackingPixels, detectTrackingPixelScripts, detectTrackingPixelElements (or shorter: detectTrackers, detectTrackerScripts, detectTrackerElements).
analysis.root_cause: Original implementation was Facebook-only; the project later expanded to 50+ networks without renaming. The names are now historic artifacts.

options.name: Direct rename to detectTracking*
options.summary: Rename detectFacebookPixel -> detectTrackingPixels, detectFacebookPixelScripts -> detectTrackingPixelScripts, detectFacebookPixelElements -> detectTrackingPixelElements. Update all callers and test describe blocks.
pros: Smallest diff that fully resolves F-CLEAN-005
Acceptance criteria are direct and easy to verify with rg
cons: No back-compat; any external consumer of the lib breaks (but this lib is internal to the extension)
options.risk_details: Pure rename. All callers are inside this repo. Pixel-detector.test.js has many references but each is mechanical.

history.note: The misleading name is original to the codebase; no prior rename attempts.
